summary: Corrected the guarded Q-Diving manual identity-discovery launcher without replaying P38 or issuing a YouTube request. Bash fail-fast is disabled only around the runner so exit 0 and exit 2 are captured, classified and followed by sanitized summary/artifact handling, while every unexpected nonzero remains a technical failure. The future default-branch launcher now fails closed on three promotion-time trust anchors: an immutable reviewed execution SHA, the confirmed Human Decision ID, and a separate immutable decision-record SHA. GitHub's historical invalid-workflow diagnostic identified runner.temp at job scope; path initialization was moved to runner scope and the workflow now registers cleanly. All 55 deterministic scripts and exact-head CI pass. PR #64 remains Ready, open, cleanly mergeable and unmerged.
